With roots in European fine art and decades of experimentation, Latchezar Boyadjiev transforms glass into powerful, emotional works that echo architecture, nature, and memory.

Meet the Artist

The Art of Shaping Glass

“I was always drawn to form — the way it breathes, the way it holds space. Classical sculpture gave me discipline, but it was glass that gave me freedom. In its fluidity and light, I found a voice that no other material could offer.”

“Working with glass is like shaping motion itself. It’s alive, transparent, and constantly shifting. In every piece, I try to capture that quiet energy — the moment between stillness and becoming.”
